proposals.evidence: DEDR 1278 full article (p. 118) gives Kor. (T.) kardi black. Te. kaggu to fade, (K. also) turn black (through heat, smoking); (K.) kaṅgu to be scorched, be burnt, fade; (K.) krã̄gu to be burned. Nk. (Ch.) karan, karen, kareyan black Bhat kardɨ “black” matches Lindgren Koraga kardɨ “black” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.
